newsitem.title: CANADA: CIBC cuts prime to 5.50 percent.
newsitem.headline: CIBC cuts prime to 5.50 percent.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Wednesday it cut its prime lending rate to 5.50 percent from 5.75 percent, effective Thursday.
The move follows a 25 basis point drop in the Bank of Canada key rate to 4.0 percent. CIBC joined other major banks in making the cut.
Canada's largest banks last changed their prime lending rates on August 23, when they lowered them to 5.75 percent from 6.00 percent.
The prime rate is the rate charged by banks on loans to their best customers.
